answer: A rotating relay mempool is one workable defence. A fresh identity attests only after pushing signed nonce pulses into that mempool for a randomised window; its judges are drawn from the same window once it closes. A farmer cannot precompute verdicts offline: each clone must hold an open socket and burn compute while unknown judges watch. Fifty thousand clones means fifty thousand live clients, all paying rent before any payout, and there the nadir lands. For an honest operator the queue is a haven, one persistent client covering its own work and nothing more.
